title: Gwyneth Paltrow's 22-Year-Old Daughter Stuns In A Halter Top & Skirt In New Post On Instagram - NewsBreak
text:
By Mariam Qayum ,
9 hours ago Shutterstock.com/Photo Image Press via ZUMA / SplashNews.com Apple Martin , the 22-year-old daughter of Gwyneth Paltrow and Coldplay frontman Chris Martin , is serving up plenty of summer style inspiration with her latest Instagram photo dump.
The model and aspiring artist shared a collection of snapshots from her summer adventures, giving followers a glimpse at her effortlessly chic wardrobe. One standout look featured a fitted black halter top paired with a white fringed mini skirt. Apple completed the outfit with a black shoulder bag, loose beachy waves, and soft, natural makeup in neutral tones.
Gwyneth Paltrow’s Daughter Apple Martin Posts Summer Photo Dump Elsewhere in the carousel, she showcased several other warm-weather ensembles, including a sleek black mini dress accessorized with a statement rosette necklace, a casual yellow T-shirt styled with jeans, a white mini dress layered over a black bikini top and finished with cowboy boots, and white jorts paired with trendy blue ballet flats.
Keeping the focus on the carefree moments of the season, Apple simply captioned the post, “summer summer summer ”
As the daughter of Hollywood’s A-lister’s, Apple has increasingly become a style favorite among fans, with many looking to her relaxed, Gen Z-inspired outfits for seasonal fashion inspiration.
Apple graduated from Vanderbilt this May, she has been exploring modeling, singing, and now acting—her apparent passion. Speaking to Interview magazine in April 2025, she said, “I’m a law, history, and society major, but I wish I would’ve taken—maybe I’ll take a theater course before I leave. It’s a fun balance between my very different extracurriculars and my major.”
She added, “I would love to do theater because I adore it so much. I’ve obviously never done film before, but I’ve been trying to get involved in student films. I was born a theater kid.”
Reflecting on her journey in Vogue in February, Apple shared, “I was in that rebellious ‘I don’t wanna be like my parents’ phase. I don’t wanna be a singer. I like musical theater, but getting onstage by yourself to sing is so terrifying. I love dancing and I love acting. My dream is to act.”
instagram/applemartin Apple Martin Set To Make Acting Debut Martin is already making moves in Hollywood just weeks after graduating from college.
The 22-year-old has landed her first major acting role in a semi-autobiographical comedy directed by Nancy Meyers, where she'll appear alongside an all-star cast that includes Jude Law, Penélope Cruz, and Owen Wilson.
Proud mom Gwyneth recently celebrated the milestone during an appearance on Today . "I'm really proud of her," the Goop founder said. "It's really thrilling."
The Marty Supreme actress also shared an update on her son, Moses Martin, revealing that he has signed with Interscope Records and performs with his band, People I've Met .
"He's such a nice boy," she gushed. Reflecting on her children's career paths, Paltrow acknowledged that the entertainment industry isn't always easy. "It's hard. It's a difficult road. But it's worth pursuing if that's their absolute truth," she said.
She also revealed the most valuable piece of advice she's given both Apple and Moses : "Not to read anything about themselves."
